topics.label: Hurricane / Catastrophe Modeling & Climate Risk
source_hints: reinsurance and catastrophe modeling industry news
topics.selection_note: Lowest priority topic. Only include when directly relevant to the user's work as a hurricane catastrophe modeler: large loss events (hurricanes, typhoons, major natural disasters), changes in climate data sources or agencies (e.g. NOAA restructuring, ERA5 updates), and significant shifts in the climate research establishment. Skip generic climate science, energy transition, or climate policy stories.

topics.label: US National & Political News
topics.selection_note: Consequential policy changes, executive actions, legislative votes, court rulings, major agency decisions. Include Illinois state politics when significant. Skip polls, campaign strategy, pundit takes, and horse-race coverage.

topics.label: Chicago Local News
topics.selection_note: User is a registered Illinois voter with Chicago ties. City council votes, transit/infrastructure developments, public safety data, and major local events. Skip routine mayoral press conferences and minor announcements.

topics.label: Water Cooler Stories
topics.selection_note: The big stories everyone is talking about that don't fit neatly into other categories. Major cultural moments, viral news, significant events that a well-informed person should know about. These are distinct from serendipity picks — water cooler stories are mainstream-big, serendipity picks are niche-interesting.

selection_note: Pick 5 stories total. Aim for variety across topics but don't force every category into every issue. Lead with whatever is genuinely most interesting today. Include 1-2 stories outside these core topics that would appeal to a curious, well-read generalist — science, culture, history, unusual economics, etc. Think: the experience of flipping through a physical newspaper, not a hyper-targeted feed.
